tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on The Milky Way

questions.question: Q: What type of galaxy is the Milky Way?
questions.correctAnswer: A barred spiral galaxy with a central bar, spiral arms, a bulge and a halo.

questions.question: Q: Where is the Sun located in the Milky Way?
questions.correctAnswer: About 26,000 light-years from the galactic centre, in the Orion Arm (a minor spiral arm).

questions.question: Q: What is Sagittarius A*?
questions.correctAnswer: The supermassive black hole at the centre of the Milky Way, with a mass of about 4 million solar masses.

tests.name: Exam-Style Practice
tests.description: Short-answer practice on The Milky Way

questions.question: Q: Why can we not see the galactic centre in visible light?
questions.correctAnswer: Dust and gas in the galactic plane absorb visible light; we observe the centre using infrared and radio wavelengths that penetrate the dust.

questions.question: Q: What evidence suggests dark matter exists in the Milky Way?
questions.correctAnswer: The rotation curves of the Milky Way show stars at the edge orbit faster than expected from visible mass alone, indicating unseen (dark) matter.
